name: hiero-sdk-v3
description: A prototyping ground for the **next generation of client SDKs ("V3")** for the [Hiero](https://hiero.org) project under Linux Foundation Decentralized Trust (LFDT). Since Hedera and other networks build on Hiero, V3 is designed for the whole ecosystem — not just Hedera.

scripts.build:proto: npx pbjs -t static-module -w es6 -p src/base/internal/proto-src --force-long --no-beautify --no-convert --no-delimited --no-verify -o src/base/internal/generated-proto.js src/base/internal/proto-src/*.proto && npx pbts -o src/base/internal/generated-proto.d.ts src/base/internal/generated-proto.js
